name: Alif Ahlam Herbs Infused Hair Oil | 100% Natural Organic Oils & Herbs
description:
Revitalize your hair naturally with Alif Ahlam Herbs Infused Hair Oil. Crafted from a 100% natural and organic blend of 15 oils and 10 herbs, this potent formula nourishes, strengthens, and promotes healthy hair growth. Perfect for all hair types, it helps reduce hair fall, adds shine, and keeps your scalp healthy and balanced.
Key Features:
 100% natural & organic formulation
 Infused with 15 oils & 10 herbs
 Strengthens hair and reduces hair fall
 Promotes healthy scalp & hair growth
 Adds shine and smoothness to hair
 Suitable for all hair types
How to Use:
 Apply directly to scalp and hair roots
 Massage gently in circular motions
 Leave for at least 1–2 hours (or overnight)
 Wash thoroughly with mild shampoo
Ingredients:
Blend of 15 Natural Oils and 10 Herbal Extracts
Safety Information:
 For external use only
 Avoid contact with eyes
 Store in a cool, dry place away from sunlight
Package Includes:
 1 × Alif Ahlam Herbs Infused Hair Oil
